## Summary of findings

The membership tier is a **computed, non-persisted** field derived at DTO-mapping time. The current implementation produces only `SILVER` or `BRONZE` — **there is no `GOLD` logic implemented**, yet an acceptance test expects `GOLD` for a 3+ member household. `householdId` is likewise a computed field derived from last name + normalized address. There is no repository method to count household members.

---

## 1. membershipTier logic (BRONZE / SILVER / GOLD)

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`
This is the ONLY place membershipTier is computed. It is a MapStruct expression on `toOwnerDto`:

```java
@Mapping(target = "membershipTier",
        expression = "java((owner.getNamesakeCount() != null && owner.getNamesakeCount() == 0 && owner.getEmail() != null && !owner.getEmail().isBlank()) ? \"SILVER\" : \"BRONZE\")")
```

Logic: `SILVER` when `namesakeCount == 0` AND email is present/non-blank; otherwise `BRONZE`. No `GOLD` branch exists. The mapper also computes `householdId` (line 25-26) and `locality` (line 29-30) via helper classes, plus `displayName` and `initials`.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (lines 2110-2115)
Schema doc for the field (this is the contract the generated `OwnerDto` comes from):
```yaml
membershipTier:
  title: Membership tier
  description: "'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'."
  type: string
  example: "SILVER"
  readOnly: true
```
Note the spec text also documents only SILVER/BRONZE — GOLD is not in the OpenAPI description either.

`membershipTier` is NOT persisted: there is no `membership_tier` column in any schema.sql. `Owner` (below) has no tier field. It is purely derived on read. (`membership_number` IS a persisted column, but that is a different field — `AssignMembershipNumber`.)

---

## 2. householdId

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/HouseholdId.java`
Static helper `HouseholdId.of(lastName, address)`. Normalizes lastName (trim, collapse whitespace, lowercase) and address (via `AddressNormalizer.normalize`), joins with `\n`, SHA-256 hashes, and returns the first 12 upper-case hex chars. Not persisted — recomputed on each read. Called from `OwnerMapper` line 26.

The same normalized last-name + normalized-address pair defines a "household", used both here and in `RejectDuplicateHousehold`.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RejectDuplicateHousehold.java`
Rejects a create when an existing owner shares the normalized lastName+address, UNLESS the request sets `sharesHousehold=true` (then it returns early, allowing multiple owners in one household). Iterates `ownerRepository.findAll()`. Throws `DuplicateHouseholdException` (→ 409). This early-return on `sharesHousehold` is what lets a household accumulate members.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AddressNormalizer.java`
Shared address canonicalizer (trim, collapse whitespace, uppercase, expand ST→STREET, RD→ROAD, AVE→AVENUE). Used by `HouseholdId`, `RejectDuplicateHousehold`, `NormalizeAddress`, `RequireOwnerFields`.

openapi.yml lines 2096-2101 document `householdId` in the schema.

---

## 3. Owner creation flow (POST /owners)

### OfficeFloor YAML: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`
Requires role `OWNER_ADMIN`. Linear pipeline (each step `next:`), all under `transaction` governance:

`normalizeAddress` → `require` (RequireOwnerFields) → `normalize` (NormalizeTelephone) → `normalizeEmail` → `rejectDuplicate` (RejectDuplicateTelephone) → `rejectDuplicateHousehold` → `rejectCityAtCapacity` → `rejectOverDailyLimit` → `build` (BuildOwner) → `assignCustomerCode` → `assignMembershipNumber` → `countNamesakes` → `flagBulkSignup` → `save` (SaveOwner) → `audit` (AuditOwnerCreated) → `respond` (RespondWithOwnerCreated).

Note: `membershipTier` and `householdId` are NOT computed in this pipeline — they are computed later when the saved Owner is mapped to `OwnerDto` (on the GET response and the create response). The pipeline only sets the persisted inputs (`namesakeCount`, etc.).

Function classes directory: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/` (37 files). Key ones read:

- `BuildOwner.java` — maps `OwnerFieldsDto`→`Owner`, defaults/adjusts `registrationDate` via `BusinessDay.adjust`.
- `CountNamesakes.java` — sets `namesakeCount` = count of existing owners with same first+last name (case-insensitive) via `findAll()`. This directly feeds the SILVER/BRONZE decision.
- `AssignCustomerCode.java` — `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, per-city sequence via `findAll()`.
- `AssignMembershipNumber.java` — `<customerCode>-M<YY>` (persisted `membershipNumber`).
- `FlagBulkSignup.java` — sets `bulkSignupWarning` when >80 owners exist for the registration day.
- `Locality.java` — city→region table for `locality`.

Other functions present (not all read): `NormalizeAddress`, `NormalizeTelephone`, `NormalizeEmail`, `RequireOwnerFields`, `RejectDuplicateTelephone`, `RejectCityAtCapacity`, `RejectOverDailyLimit`, `SaveOwner`, `AuditOwnerCreated`, `RespondWithOwnerCreated`, plus exception types (`DuplicateHouseholdException`, `CityAtCapacityException`, `DailyLimitExceededException`, `InvalidEmailException`, `InvalidTelephoneException`, `MissingOwnerFieldsException`, `DuplicateTelephoneException`), and helpers `BusinessDay`, `TelephoneE164`.

### Owner entity: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
Persisted fields: `address`, `city`, `telephone`, `email`, `registrationDate`, `customerCode`, `membershipNumber` (col `membership_number`), `namesakeCount` (col `namesake_count`), `bulkSignupWarning` (col `bulk_signup_warning`), `pets`. Extends `Person` (firstName/lastName). **No `membershipTier` and no `householdId` fields — both are derived in the mapper only.**

### OwnerRepository: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java`
Methods: `findByLastName(String)`, `findByLastName(String, Pageable)`, `findById(int)`, `save(Owner)`, `findAll()`, `findAll(Pageable)`, `delete(Owner)`. **No household-count or household-member query exists.** All the counting functions (namesakes, city sequence, bulk signup, duplicate household) iterate `findAll()`.

Spring Data impl: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/springdatajpa/SpringDataOwnerRepository.java` (JPQL for the above; no household query). Other impls: `jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`, `jdbc/JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`.

---

## 4. Tests related to membership tier / owner creation

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`
The single test `coreGoldForThreeMemberHousehold` (checkpoint "tier-gold"):
- Comment: *"membershipTier is 'GOLD' when the owner's household has 3+ members after this create."*
- Builds a shared household: creates 2 owners with the same `lastName`+`address` and `sharesHousehold=true`, then a 3rd (also `sharesHousehold=true`).
- Asserts: `getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.membershipTier").value("GOLD"))`.

This test currently would FAIL against the existing mapper, which never returns `GOLD`. The GOLD rule (household size ≥ 3) is unimplemented — there is no member-count computation and no persisted household count.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`
Base harness (black-box over `POST /api/owners` and `GET /api/owners/{id}`). Relevant helpers: `ownerNode()` (fully-unique valid owner), `createOwnerOk`, `getOwner`, `uniqueLastName`, `uniqueAddress`. `@Transactional` rollback + `@WithMockUser(roles OWNER_ADMIN...)`. Note: the payload in the GOLD test adds `sharesHousehold=true` (handled by `RejectDuplicateHousehold`); `ownerNode()` does not set email, so those owners would compute BRONZE under the current SILVER/BRONZE rule.

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`
Test utility to capture `AUDIT` logger events (used for audit-side-effect assertions). No tier logic.

No other test files exist under `src/test` (only these three in the `acceptance` package).

---

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Normalized to E.164 form on input (a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped); stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-() +0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must fall on a business day; if the effective date (supplied or defaulted) is a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the next Monday, and that adjusted date is stored and used for all derived values.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address (they share a household). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of owners already in that city at assignment time.
              type: string
              example: "LON-SMI-0007"
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Server-assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: "LON-SMI-0007-M26"
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned identifier shared by every owner with the same last name and address (one household), so owners created with sharesHousehold true share it. Derived deterministically from the last name and address, so it is stable across requests.
              type: string
              example: "A1B2C3D4E5F6"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners at creation time sharing the same firstName and lastName (case-insensitively), counted before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: "'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'."
              type: string
              example: "SILVER"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
